intentions.title: Serialize Barkpark book documents into EDItEUR-conformant ONIX 3.0 XML that trading partners (Bokbasen first) can ingest
intentions.evidence: export.ex builds RecordReference/DescriptiveDetail/CollateralDetail/PublishingDetail/ProductSupply per the ONIX 3.0 spec; export_controller.ex streams XML per-book over HTTP; export.ex sanitizes illegal XML control chars before serialization to keep every document exportable.

intentions.title: Never let an ONIX export or Bokbasen submission emit or transmit schema-invalid XML
intentions.evidence: export.ex to_iodata/to_string/to_file all gate on Validator.validate_xsd against the vendored EDItEUR XSD, returning {:error,{:xsd_invalid,_}} rather than emitting; codelist_raise? boundary converts unseeded-code raises (ArgumentError/FunctionClauseError) into a structured {:invalid_code,_} envelope so an unrenderable field never 500s the export controller, the dryrun preview, or the Bokbasen PublishWorker.

intentions.title: Make Bokbasen submission a byproduct of the normal Publish click, not a separate manual step
intentions.evidence: lifecycle.ex after_publish hook (Goal barkpark-9lq) enqueues Bokbasen.PublishWorker automatically for `book` docs on publish; explicit recursion guard on ctx.source == :worker prevents the worker's own publish_document call from re-enqueueing itself forever; manual 'Publish to Bokbasen' action (actions.ex) stays available for dry-run preview and retry.

intentions.title: Give ops staff a real-time console to monitor and recover every Bokbasen submission through its state machine
intentions.evidence: web/bokbasen_live.ex: admin LiveView at /admin/onixedit/bokbasen (auth: :ops), sortable/filterable table over pending→staging→staged→polling→accepted/rejected/failed/cancelled/cannot_cancel, per-doc PubSub subscription 'bokbasen:document:<id>' for live pill updates, Retry action gated to terminal-error states with unique-key protection against double-enqueue.

intentions.title: Keep Bokbasen publish/retry actions tenant-scoped so cross-workspace same-ID books never cross-contaminate
intentions.evidence: lifecycle.ex scope_of/1 + PublishWorker.put_scope_args capture workspace_id/project_id into enqueued job args (barkpark-zdvi); bokbasen_live.ex retry handler explicitly re-derives scope from the loaded Document row rather than trusting the admin console's dataset=='production' global listing.

intentions.title: Track ONIX codelist drift as ONIX registry issues advance, and let editors consciously acknowledge rather than be silently blocked by stale pins
intentions.evidence: codelists/staleness_checker.ex: pure detect_stale/2 classifies every codelistId+issue_version ref as current/stale/deprecated/acknowledged; revalidate/2 diffs a document's refs against a live registry snapshot (added/removed/changed); staleness_acknowledged:true flag turns stale/deprecated into acknowledged without masking accurate :current data; consumed by staleness_live.ex admin UI and a mix codelists.staleness task.

intentions.title: Provide OnixEdit's Studio-editor surface (schema sub-modules, actions, routes, menu, CLI, ping) as thin, self-registering plugin wiring over the ONIX domain logic
intentions.evidence: actions.ex is explicitly a stateless dispatch shim (no LiveView/GenServer state) that StudioLive calls into for kind:link/kind:modal schema actions; schemas.ex is a sub-schema index/namespace; contributor.ex/text_content.ex/thema_subject_category.ex define individual ONIX field sub-schemas; ping_live.ex is a route-highway smoke test — mirrors the repo's plugin-thin/core-thick doctrine (Bulldocs/Sheets pattern) applied to ONIX.
